title: Conterminous
summary: Sharing a common boundary, or contained within the same boundaries. Synonym of contiguous. E.g. 'the conterminous United States' refers to the 48 states excluding Alaska and Hawaii.
whyItMatters: The term is used to distinguish the logically or physically connected parts of a territory from its exclaves. In the US, it is essential for distinguishing the 'lower 48' from the non-contiguous states.
notes: Often confused with 'contiguous', which carries the same meaning of sharing a border. In geographic contexts, conterminous emphasizes the sharing of a boundary edge.
